GHSA-qr4g-8hrp-c4rw is the unrestricted-outbound-request variant of the kyverno apiCall SSRF family. reports-server imports only kyverno type packages and the generated clientset; it does not import or execute pkg/engine/apicall, so the vulnerable code path is not shipped.

GHSA-gg4x-fgg2-h9w9 is a policy-exception bypass in the kyverno policy engine. reports-server does not evaluate policies or policy exceptions; it imports only kyverno type packages and the generated clientset, so pkg/engine and pkg/controllers/policyexceptions are not shipped.

GHSA-fmqp-4wfc-w3v7 is an SSRF in the kyverno apiCall executor. reports-server imports only kyverno type packages and the generated clientset; it does not import or execute pkg/engine/apicall, so the SSRF code path is not shipped.

GHSA-f9g8-6ppc-pqq4 covers the same apiCall ServiceAccount token injection as GHSA-8wfp-579w-6r25. reports-server imports only kyverno type packages (api/reports/v1, api/policyreport/v1alpha2) and the generated clientset; it does not import or execute pkg/engine/apicall, so the vulnerable code path is not shipped.

GHSA-cvq5-hhx3-f99p is the incomplete-fix follow-up to CVE-2026-22039 in the kyverno configMap context loader. reports-server does not evaluate policies or load policy contexts; it imports only kyverno type packages and the generated clientset, so pkg/engine/context/loaders/configmap is not shipped.

GHSA-8wfp-579w-6r25 affects the kyverno apiCall executor which auto-attaches a ServiceAccount bearer token. reports-server imports only kyverno type packages (api/reports/v1, api/policyreport/v1alpha2) and the generated clientset; it does not import or execute pkg/engine/apicall, so the leaking code path is not shipped.

CVE-2026-40868 affects the kyverno apiCall ServiceCall executor in pkg/engine/apicall. reports-server imports only kyverno type packages (api/reports/v1, api/policyreport/v1alpha2) and the generated clientset; it does not import or execute the policy engine, so the apiCall code path is not shipped.

GHSA-f9g8-6ppc-pqq4 covers the same apiCall ServiceAccount token injection as GHSA-8wfp-579w-6r25 at pkg/engine/apicall/executor.go. The kyverno admission controller exercises this executor during policy evaluation. Upstream fix is in Kyverno 1.16.4; the packaged 1.15.3 and 1.16.3 lines are below that and no 1.15.x backport has been published. Tracking upstream.

The kyverno admission controller loads ConfigMap context via pkg/engine/context/loaders/configmap.go, whose NewConfigMapLoader does not validate the target namespace (CVE-2026-41068). Upstream fix is in Kyverno 1.17.2; the packaged 1.15.3, 1.16.3, and 1.17.1 lines are below that and no 1.15.x or 1.16.x backport has been published. Tracking upstream.

The kyverno admission controller evaluates policies at admission time and exercises the apiCall executor at pkg/engine/apicall/executor.go when policies use apiCall service mode. Upstream fix is in Kyverno 1.16.4; the packaged 1.15.3 and 1.16.3 lines are below that and no 1.15.x backport has been published. Tracking upstream.

GHSA-f9g8-6ppc-pqq4 covers the same apiCall ServiceAccount token injection as GHSA-8wfp-579w-6r25. kyverno-cleanup-controller wires factories.DefaultContextLoaderFactory in pkg/controllers/cleanup/controller.go and can therefore reach pkg/engine/apicall/executor.go when a CleanupPolicy uses an apiCall context. Upstream fix is in Kyverno 1.16.4; the packaged 1.15.3 and 1.16.3 lines are below that and no 1.15.x backport has been published. Tracking upstream.

kyverno-cleanup-controller wires factories.DefaultContextLoaderFactory in pkg/controllers/cleanup/controller.go and can therefore reach the ConfigMap loader at pkg/engine/context/loaders/configmap.go (CVE-2026-41068) when a CleanupPolicy uses a configMap context. Upstream fix is in Kyverno 1.17.2; the packaged 1.15.3, 1.16.3, and 1.17.1 lines are below that and no 1.15.x or 1.16.x backport has been published. Tracking upstream.

Upstream fix is in Kyverno 1.16.4; the packaged 1.15.3 and 1.16.3 lines are below that and no 1.15.x backport has been published. Tracking upstream.
